text:
sara-peopleops: FYI — manager escalation for Priya (EM). Approval was pushed in Lattice but manager says the effective date should be 2026-03-15, not 2026-03-01. Payroll cutoff in 2 days. Need quick ops guidance on backpay and documentation. :urgent:

mike-eng-manager: yep, I approved on 2026-03-01 but team agreed on 3/15 as start for budget reasons. I forgot to update the effective date in the approval flow. My bad. What's the shortest path to get Priya the correct retro?

ben-hr-ops: we can do manual backpay if payroll hasn't processed. Need: 1) manager approval note (explicit effective date change), 2) original approval record, 3) comp director sign-off for retro beyond cutoff, 4) payroll ticket before cutoff. Uploads to the backpay form here: https://intranet.redwood/payroll/backpay

priya: hi all — thanks. To confirm: salary moved from $165k -> $180k, effective 3/15, prorated for March and April? Manager said no changes to bonus.

jess-payroll: payroll-bot shows next run 2026-03-25 18:00 UTC, cutoff 2026-03-24 23:59 UTC. If we get ticket + approvals by EOD 3/24 we can include retro in the March run; otherwise it goes into April with manual adjustment. :calendar:

payroll-bot: Payroll run scheduled: 2026-03-25T18:00:00Z. Cutoff: 2026-03-24T23:59:00Z. Manual adjustments require ticket ID and signed approval document.

mike-eng-manager: what do you need for the approval note? simple Slack thread OK or do you need signed PDF?

ben-hr-ops: short answer: PDF/email from manager with explicit language is safest. Template below — copy into manager email and cc comp director + people-ops:

```
Subject: Retroactive Salary Effective Date Change for Priya (EMPID 12345)

I, Mike [last name], approve changing the effective date for Priya's promotion from 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-15. New annual salary: $180,000. Retroactive pay for 2026-03-15 through payroll cutoff to be included in the March payroll run. I confirm no other comp components are changed.

Manager signature: Mike [last]
Date: 2026-03-23
```

ben-hr-ops: once you have that, open a payroll ticket with subject "Backpay request - Priya 12345 - effective 2026-03-15" and attach the approval + Lattice snapshot. Tag @jess-payroll so we can triage.

mike-eng-manager: will send now. One more Q: international tax implications — Priya is UK-based. Anything special?

ben-hr-ops: yes — for UK employees we need payroll tax coding check. Please include country in ticket and payroll will loop in tax team. If retro crosses tax month boundaries we might need separate filings. Flag it in the ticket as "INTERNATIONAL-TAX: UK".

priya: thanks — appreciate the clarity. Quick ask: will this change affect equity vest schedule or bonus targets?

ben-hr-ops: equity grant schedules shouldn't be affected by promo effective date in most cases; grant dates are separate. Bonus target is tied to role/level — comp team will confirm but when in doubt include a note in the ticket and comp will advise.

jess-payroll: once we have ticket + approvals we do a preliminary calc and confirm payout amount. Rough calc (example):

```
old_salary = 165000
new_salary = 180000
proration_days = (31 - 14)  # 3/15 through 3/31 => 17 days
annual_day_rate = (new_salary - old_salary) / 365
retro_pay = annual_day_rate * proration_days
```

jess-payroll: we'll share the exact cents in the ticket. Also note: manual adjustments processed after cutoff may be taxed in the month we run them depending on local law.

mike-eng-manager: emailed the signed approval and attached the Lattice snapshot. Ticket created: PAY-2026-4827, cc'd @ben-hr-ops and @jess-payroll.

payroll-bot: Ticket PAY-2026-4827 acknowledged. Status: awaiting payroll calc and comp director sign-off.

ben-hr-ops: I'll route to comp director for sign-off now. Please leave this thread open until payroll confirms inclusion in March run.

lattice-bot: Lattice snapshot for Priya (EMPID 12345) attached to ticket PAY-2026-4827. Approval history shows manager approval on 2026-03-01, update requested 2026-03-23.

jess-payroll: quick note re: edge cases — if manager-requested effective date is earlier than the approval date we need an exception memo. Not the case here, but documenting.

ben-hr-ops: comp director signed off at 16:10 UTC. I'm attaching sign-off to PAY-2026-4827.

payroll-bot: PAY-2026-4827 status updated: approved for March run. Processing window: include retro.

mike-eng-manager: amazing, thanks team. :heart:

priya: thank you everyone!

ben-hr-ops: closing notes for docs: 1) use manager email template above; 2) include Lattice snapshot; 3) create payroll ticket with country flag if international; 4) expect tax treatment variance — notify employee; 5) comp director sign-off required for any retro > 30 days. I'll update the internal playbook with this flow.
